title.narrative: EaP Trade Helpdesk

description.narrative: Creation of an EaP Trade Helpdesk to support trade exchanges between EaP countries and with the EU. The project will achieve the above through 6 outputs: * The EaP Trade Helpdesk portal, featuring a Market Information component and a Helpdesk component; * Step-by-step documentation guides, available through the portal, that detail the administrative procedures required to export selected products from the six EaP countries to the EU market; * Surveys in each country to identify the regulation
